templates.baseline_v1: Indication: {indication}. Analyze this chest radiograph and provide detailed findings and diagnostic impression.
templates.report_v2:
You are a radiologist. Write the radiology report for this frontal chest X-ray.
Clinical indication: {indication}.
Use exactly two sections:
FINDINGS: describe the heart, mediastinum, lungs, pleura and bones.
IMPRESSION: a one-sentence diagnostic summary.
Be concise and state normal findings when the study is normal.
templates.report_v3: Write a concise chest X-ray radiology report with a FINDINGS section and an IMPRESSION section. Indication: {indication}.
